_comment: Command `<COM>_Climax` kojo (Plan_KojoTemplates.md §7.11): fetched per side only while that side is climaxing (EvaluationPackage.LogMessage_Climax); listener = the other side, or itself when there is none.
label: 指令高潮口上
_comment_required: fallback: the role branch must be a fallback for that role with these fields. A doer climaxing on a receiver who can't act (asleep, time-stopped …) fails a default doer branch (requireTargetAction true) and would fall through to the shared fallback, written from the receiver's side. An entry with no doer branch at all is flagged too: a pair command's doer can climax.
